description: Search approved project-shared memory and this user’s private memory by words in their content, with offset/limit pagination. Requires the memory:read grant. Returns matching memories, total count and next-page offset.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return in this page.

offset.description: Number of matching results to skip; use the previous response’s nextOffset for another page.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

query.description: Search words describing the item or content to find.

name: playground_memory_search
title: Search Playground project memory
